nom: Origins Checks And Balances Milky Oil Cleanser + Makeup Melter

avis.texte: It removed make up okay. It also did not get the grits out of my pores like a normal pol cleanser does. That i can forgive, but then it broke me out so bad on my nose and cheeks after 1 use. Not a fan.
I don't like it. Glad I got it during a sale. Can't return not even sure if I will use it all or just throw it away
This product just doesn't effectively remove makeup. Hard pass.
I bought this because I like the Checks and Balances face wash. It works fine to take makeup off but I don't the bottle design or smell. I will use it up but will go back to DHC oil cleanser.

Ive semi recently gotten into oil cleansers and came by this the other day in store. On a whim i purchased it and ill be returning it. Ive used it day and night for a few days now and i can say im not impressed. Previously i was using Anuas cleansing oil and ill probably return to that bottle today. Origins is so thick it doesnt spread well. I had to reapply twice to get my makeup off and i dont use thick makeup. I dont wear foundation, aome light under eye from ilia, light mascara and some blush. But it would not get the mascara off. Makeuo removal for ouls is the easiest thing ive ever tried and the fact this took two times over was just ridiculous. Do not recommend, maybe if you just plan on using it in the morning since you dont typivally need heavy cleansing that time of day.

I was very hopeful for this product, but I found it to be kinda mediocre for a bi-phase cleanser. 1. I found that it did not do anything for the sebaceous filaments on my nose (waxy round "plugs" from my nose pores), while other first step oil cleansers are effective at removing them. I ended up using a 3rd step mith a microexfoliant (which I never use) after my 2nd cleanser, and basically ended up irritating my skin. 2. It is terrible for removing eye makeup because it is so irritating. I kept my eyes tightly closed to remove mascara but my eyelids became red and swollen using this anyway. I thought the ingredients sounded so great but I don't think I can use this because of how much it hurts my eyes. It might be OK for some people, so I give it 2 stars.

I don't have sensitive skin at all, but this oil irritated the skin around my eyes. It was too painful to continue so I quickly washed it off and used my HG oil, which is gentle. I can't say I recommend this because I couldn't even get past the burning to see if it removed my eye makeup.
This takes off make up for nicely for me. Smells wonder too and not greasy or oily

It's a yikes from me. I've really tried to like it and forced myself to use it multiple times, besides the fact that it feels awful, it doesnt remove makeup well at all, especially around eyes. I got it for 50% off during 21 days of beauty and I feel like I still overpaid. I have to use makeup remover and a 2nd/3rd cleanse of anither product to remove the makeup. Better and cheaper cleansers out there that actually work.
Amazing! 10/10! Makeup melts away! Great for sensitive skin and for eye makeup!
It makes my skin soft but I still need micellar to get off mascara even after a good scrub.
Does not remove eye makeup easily , I prefer DHC oil over this
This oil is pretty greasy! It felt really heavy compared to other make up removal facial oils that have used in the past. Did not care for the smell. This oil has a weird scent to it.

Smells really bad. Not like off-putting, but I wonder every time I use it if it's gone bad or even safe to put on my skin. Doesn't glide along skin smoothly so you have to keep applying more and more. I love the Checks and Balances foaming cleanser so I thought this would be a hit. Can't be used around eyes like others say. This one product has basically turned me off from the whole brand. I feel bamboozled. There are cheaper oil cleansers that don't smell like burning tires and don't burn your eyes. Pass.

I've been using this for a couple months now. Most of my make up does come off pretty easily. I am impressed on how well it loosens my makeup around my eyes. Sometimes I need wipe off the remaining makeup with cleansing wipes (I use the Burts Bee's brand).
This is not safe for eyes. Def burns. Also only positive reviews are the ones who were gifted this product.
I'm a long term fan of Origins. The oil did the job but hurt my eyes. Yes, it's clean up your eye make up but stings your eyes. I won't purchase again.
I was excited for this product. However, it did not worked for me. It doesn't remove eye makeup properly i am left with raccoon eyes. This is going back unfortunately.

I give this a 20 out 10!!! By far the best makeup remover/face wash. In ONE use everything comes off- unlike other removers where you need a cotton swab or wipe and takes multiple rounds. This is gentle- doesnt burn your eyes, leave your skin SO soft and moisturized. You dont even need a lot of product- a few drops. Must try…
I dont hate it but i dont love it. I feel i use an excessive amount to get the job done.

I had high hopes. With the oil layer, i thought that would help wash out mascara. But it works just like a basic cleanser. Even with using this with my cleanser, I still got the same result as with just using my cleanser alone. Now I don't know what to do with this bottle.

I LOVE Origins, and I'm a big oil cleanser fan, so I was so excited to try this product!! Overall, like it quite a bit, but the packaging is difficult for me to get behind. As someone who usually removes their makeup in the shower, having a pump on this would be sooo much easier. The cleanser itself was a little bit thick in comparison to my favorite oil cleansers, but I can get past that because of how great it worked and made my skin feel.

avis.titre: Great if you're into full glam!
avis.texte: Amazing makeup dissolver!!! I have very sentive and dry skin, i also really dislike when soaps/oil irritate my eyes so this one is my tried-and-true. I wear full glam makeup everyday for work so ill shake a few drops of this product onto a cloth (like micellar water) and remove as much makeup as i can, and its easy with this stuff. Ill then go in with Lancôme's creme wash to remove the rest. Takes off absolutely everything, even stubborn eyelash glue! Definitely have added this one to my routine.

I absolutely love this stuff. It's not like a micellar water where it leaves behind a weird texture on my face, it just leaves it feeling super clean. I still do wash my face with my cleaner, but this is a nice double cleanser.

I have liked Origins products until the last year or so. I received a full size of this "cleanser" as a gift from Ulta. It doesn't cleanse. It doesn't remove waterproof eye makeup - it only smears it into a mess. Personally I feel one shouldn't have to use 2 "cleansers". Regular Checks and Balances frothy face wash does an infinitely better job at taking off all of your makeup and leaving your skin fresh. If you want a better makeup remover with an oily texture, try First Aid Beauty 2-in-1 cleansing oil.
I recently received this product as a gift and love it! It works well in a double-cleansing routine and leaves my face soft.

Lerfect oul cleanser for someone looking for a pre wash oil cleanser for when the cleansing balms can be a bit heavy. Ise on a dry face, massage off any makeup, add a bit of water and continue to massagr, then rinse and follow up with choice facewash.
I wanted to love this but unfortunately it's the opposite! I prefer DHS over this one! Product did not take off my make up! Sorry!

I feel like i might be one of the first reviews that actually purchased the product and didnt recieve it as a promo. First off the packaging is horrible. It comes out of a dropper top so you have to keep shaking the bottle for just little drops to come out at a time. I understand its and oil and they dont want it just running out, but a dropper that comes with serums would work perfectly for this. As far as the actual product formulation, its alright as a cleansing oil, as far as melting make up and removing that is subpar, didnt even have on waterproof mascara and it took two "washes" of this product and still had to go back with a different remover to get all my eye makeup off. Overall would not recommend and wouldnt buy again
I love the results and it gives my skin a glow. I used it with the foamy cleanser for a double cleansing

I've used the Clear Improvement Oil Cleanser from Origins for years now and I like it BUTTTT I think this one does do more heavy duty cleaning. I don't wear makeup lightly so I have to do a little more scrubbing, but this product got it off without using so much. I tried it on my eyes like in the photos, but it burned a bit is the only thing I don't like but overall I love it!

First, let me say I love a good skin care product and this right here is the holy grail. The moment you apply this product it's like you feel all of the makeup and everyday stress just slip away especially, once you rinse it off. RUN DONT WALK!!! 😍

I've definitely used better oil cleansers. It's not the greatest at taking off my eye makeup but it gets the job done eventually although it's pretty irritating to the eyes. I love origins but there really isn't anything special about this cleanser.

avis.titre: I actually liked it more than I thought I would
avis.texte: I use this as the first step in my nightly routine as a pre-cleanser. I love it!
I love this cleanser it was great for removing make up. However, if you get this stuff in your eyes, it burns like no other. Which is unfortunate with how well it takes off make up

Complimentary from origins US. I love all of origins products especially this makeup remover! I love how it leaves my face soft and smooth after using it. It doesn't leave it dry like how other makeup removers I use do. I also love how clean my face looks after using it.

avis.titre: LOVE this cleanser paired with original C&B
avis.texte: I wear alot of makeup (estee lauder double wear) so I love to double cleanse to make sure my skin is squeaky clean! I have always used the original Checks and Balances which I love but I recently picked this up and use it to double cleanse. My skin is oily and even though this cleanser is an oil, I dont feel like it makes my skin oilier at all. It quickly dissolves all my layers of makeup and I really like that its a liquid and I dont need to dig my fingers into a balm as I have long nails. Overall Im in love and will definitely repurchase!!

I received this product complimentary from Origins US and wanted to share my honest review. I love using it to remove makeup from my skin. It's really lightweight and feels pleasant to use and really gets in there. I have sensitive skin and it doesn't cause irritation after using.

I love this as the first step in a double cleanse. It removes my makeup easily and without harsh rubbing, bonus points for not irritating my eyes! I love the packaging and how portable it is, so great for an overnight bag or vacation! Gifted by Origins US.

I was gifted by Origins US and am obsessed! It truly melts your makeup away after a long day! It's oil based so if you have super oily skin I would maybe stay away. A little bit will go a long way so you definitely get your moneys worth! Highly recommend trying it out!

Ugh, what a GEM this cleanser is! I absolutely love it for when I'm traveling: my skin often dries when I fly. This truly cleanses the skin, without stripping my face of its natural oils. My face is left soft, clean- and truly aids in helping with sugar breakouts! Highly recommend this cleanser for everyday use. Gifted by origins US

Gifted by Origins. I was gifted this product for free from the company and I am so excited to use it! I love using Origins products because they make my skin feel so healthy and refreshed! I am very excited to use this product!

Origins Us gifted me with the Checks & Balances Milky Oil Cleanser and I can honestly say that this product does exactly what the label says. REMOVES MAKEUP! I have never used a oil cleanser before, but after using this one I'M HOOKED

Hands down one of my favorite cleansing oil. I always double cleanse whether I have makeup on or not. This melts your makeup and does a deep clean which I love. I use this as a first step. I got this complimentary from Origins

I really like this cleanser. I always double cleanse so this is the first cleanser that I use. It's very gentle on the skin and perfect to cleanse away make up. It's oily then turns milky with water. Gifted by origin us

Greta product to remove makeup! It doesn't feel too oily on the skin and breaks down my makeup at the end of the day super easy. One of the best part is that it has no scent which makes it easy to use. Gifted by Origins.

Greta product to remove makeup! It doesn't feel too oily on the skin and breaks down my makeup at the end of the day super easy. One of the best part is that it has no scent which makes it easy to use. Gifted by Origins.

This oil cleanser is ideal. If you are somebody that wants to double cleanse. It is not a pore clogging like some other oil based cleansers that I have tried. I really like it and I did a really good job at removing waterproof mascara. Gifted by origins us

Love this for removing my makeup and as my first cleanse. It's gentle on my eyes but tough enough to remove all my makeup, even lash glue. It always leaves my skin cleaner and softer without ever over stripping. Gifted by Origins US in exchange for my honest review.

I love this cleanser gifted by Origins! I have very sensitive skin so I'm picky with what skincare products I use. This removes all the gunk effectively and makes my skin feel so clean and smooth. I also haven't broke out at all since using this!

This makeup remover oil is very lightweight and gentle on the skin. It melts my makeup so easily including my waterproof mascara. I love that it doesn't irritate or burn the eyes and it doesn't leave an oily residue. Overall I do love this product! It was complimentary from Orgins.

I LOVE this cleanser! I was skeptical to use an oil cleanser because I have oily and acne prone skin but I was pleasantly surprised by this. It does a great job of removing make up and what not and didn't leave my skin feeling greasy. I was gifted by Origins US.

I love this product! It is the perfect size for travel and arrived gifted by Origins US just before I left for coachella! I used it at night to take of all of my makeup, glitter, and dirt for the day and I couldn't have brought a better product. Amazing!

Origins Checks & Balances Milky Oil Cleanser is a game-changer for anyone looking for a gentle yet effective way to remove makeup and impurities. It effortlessly dissolves even waterproof mascara without leaving a greasy residue. Gifted by Origins US

This is a great cleansing oil. You shake the bottle to mix it up. I use this on dry skin and does a really good job taking off my makeup. Once I add water, it turns milky and rinses clean. Gifted by Origins

avis.titre: Does the work but heavy consistency!
avis.texte: This was great at getting my make up off and really did do what it promised. However, it was very oily and heavy to use as a cleanser on my face. I have a preference for more light weight products so this just wasn't personally meant for me. Gifted by origins.

This product was fine. I only got a sample so I didn't really get to try it out for very long. The smell is fine and it made my skin feel clean, but unsure of the actual benefits would maybe recommend gifted by origins US

I love this cleanser so so much! I have very sensitive skin so I am very glad I found something that doesn't tire my skin when cleansing so I highly recommend !!! Be careful not to get in your eyes btw :) I was gifted by Origins US

This is the perfect product for removing makeup easily. I take a little bit and put it on a cleansing pad and use it to wipe foundation and eye makeup off. This product works especially well at breaking down my eyelash glue which not all makeup removers can easily do. So far, very impressed. This product was gifted by origins US in exchange for my honest review.

avis.titre: Adding it to my skincare routine
avis.texte: complimentary from Origins I have been extremely impressed with its effectiveness. This product is perfect for those with combination or oily skin, as it effectively removes makeup and impurities without leaving the skin feeling dry or stripped. The cleanser has a creamy texture that feels luxurious on the skin, and it effectively removes all traces of makeup, including stubborn waterproof mascara. I love that it doesn't leave any residue on the skin, and it leaves my face feeling clean and refreshed. One of the things I appreciate about this product is that it contains natural ingredients like lavender, white tea, and rice bran, which help to soothe and nourish the skin. I have noticed that my skin looks brighter and more even-toned since I started using this cleanser. Overall, I would highly recommend the Origins Balances Milky Cleanser and Makeup Remover to anyone looking for an effective and gentle cleanser that can remove makeup and impurities without stripping the skin. It's a great addition to any skincare routine, and I will definitely be purchasing it in the future.

I'm so obsessed I love the way this melts away my makeup without making it feel oily. I'm so obsessed with the smell as well. I definitely will be purchasing more soon. I'm already almost out of the remover Gifted by origins US

It did a really great job taking off all my make up. I got a travel size so I will probably use this more on vacations, but it did a really great job cleansing the skin and prepping it for the rest of the skin care routine. Gifted by Origins US.

I got a sample size of this product to review that was gifted by Origins US. This Is pretty nice to use as a double cleanser and feels extremely lightweight. It does well on removing makeup. The consistency is more on the watery side.

This milky oil cleaner is the best, I love how easy it is to take off my make up. I love how gentle it is on my skin, I love that I just have to shake up the oil cleanser and it works so well to get rid of my makeup. gifted by Origins US.

This was gifted by origins to me! This was my first time using an oil cleanser and I really liked it! Even after I washed it off my fave felt so soft and hydrated. Since it's an oil you only need a tiny bit. I never had any skin irritation from it either so that's a win! I will continue to finish the whole bottle

I love this as a first step in my cleansing routine! It does such a nice job removing all my make up, especially stubborn eye make up before I go in with another cleanser to truly clean the skin. This is great to travel with as well! Gifted by Origins

Complimentary from Origins. I love this product so far! I just got into double cleansing (oil cleanser first, then foam cleanser) and this is a really nice first step in my double cleanse. It removes my stubborn waterproof eyeliner and leaves my skin soft.

Does a good job removing waterproof mascara too. Little goes a long way, it effortlessly removes my makeup. It removes the dirt as well as makeup and cleans my pores deeply, leaving my skin soft and smooth.

This cleanser does a good job of melting away makeup and sunscreen. It emulsifies into a milky lather when I add water and is easy to wash off. I particularly enjoy using this alone in the morning because my skin feels so comfortable after! Gifted by Origins.

I love multipurpose products and this cleanser and makeup remover is the perfect addition for those days of the week where I wear makeup. It can be used morning or night which is also a plus. Gifted by Origins US.

I love this cleanser it makes my skin feel so smooth, and it really gets my makeup off similar to a cleansing balm for removal. I definitely wouldn't use this every day, but like using it when I'm taking my makeup off. gifted by origins us

Love this oil cleanser. Love how it removes all my makeup easily. It's really easy to apply and not at all harsh on my skin. It makes my skin look and feel amazing! Would totally recommend this product. Gifted by Origins US.

This is such a great and gentle makeup cleanser. I apply it in the morning and night in my dry face and eyes. I massage a bit and add water to emulsify. It effectively removes all of my makeup and leaves my skin clean and soft. Gifted by The Origins

This product is worth the try! A great first step cleanser if your wear heavy makeup it may take a while to work on with this but goes pretty well on taking SpF and just basic makeup which worked great for me. Gifted by Origins US
